# reference: OpenBSD sys/net/pf_norm.c:pf_reassemble; sys/net/pf.c:pf_normalize_ip; FreeBSD sys/netpfil/pf/pf_norm.c
# support: donor-only (raven-pf at a426dee0 has no fragment model)
# With `scrub ... fragment reassemble`, pf_reassemble queues an incomplete
# fragment and returns PF_PASS with *m0 == NULL, so the fragment is consumed
# and not forwarded. The completed datagram is filtered once, and its verdict
# is the third row. `queued` is a fixture state, not a forward verdict.
# The final field is the byte offset and More-Fragments flag.
# now direction interface proto source sport destination dport length flags expected disposition fragment
